title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: communication memory and the Enhanced personalization control
summary: Hold for corrections to the access and discovery guidance. Delegated Graph access requires both permission and a supported administrator role, not either one; the discovery instructions also omit the exclusion of custom instructions and Graph Explorer's government-cloud limitations.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Enhanced personalization processes Teams chats, Outlook emails, transcripts, Microsoft 365 usage, profile information and connector data.
claims.quote: such as Microsoft Teams chats, Outlook emails, Microsoft transcripts, Microsoft 365 usage data, user profile information such as role, and data from connectors.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Personalization information is confidential and not shared with other users.
claims.quote: this information remains confidential and is not shared with other users, ensuring user privacy.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Copilot memories are stored in a hidden folder in the user's Exchange mailbox.
claims.quote: Memories, which include saved memories, details inferred from chat history and custom instructions, are stored in the user's Exchange mailbox in a hidden folder.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Memories follow the same security and compliance policies as other mailbox data.
claims.quote: Thus, memories follow the same security and compliance policies as other mailbox data, such as Customer Lockbox and encryption at rest.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Purview retention policies and retention labels do not apply to Copilot memory.
claims.quote: Retention policies and retention labels configured in Purview by organization admins don't apply to Copilot memory.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: No admin controls enforce retention rules specifically for Copilot memory.
claims.quote: There are no admin controls to enforce retention rules specifically for Copilot memory.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Admins cannot restrict what type of information is added to Copilot memory.
claims.quote: No, admins can't restrict what type of information is added to Copilot memory.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Administrators can search users' memory with Purview eDiscovery or Content Search without an exclusion for custom instructions.
claims.quote: Admins can search their users' memory in Microsoft Copilot via Microsoft Purview eDiscovery or Content Search. Custom instructions aren't yet discoverable in these solutions.
claims.fix: Add to the search guidance in Risk assessment and Governance controls: 'Custom instructions are not yet discoverable in eDiscovery or Content Search; users can manually export them through Settings > Personalization.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/copilot-personalization-memory.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Copilot memory is searched under item class IPM.Contact and appears in the CopilotMemory folder in an export.
claims.quote: If you export all items in this item class <IPM.Contact> for a user, their Copilot memory is located in the <'CopilotMemory'> folder.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Memory and personalization actions do not generate Purview audit log entries.
claims.quote: Memory and personalization actions don't generate audit log entries in Purview.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Users can delete a communication memory only by deleting its original source message or email.
claims.quote: A user can delete their communication memory only by deleting the original source (message or email).

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: With Enhanced personalization off, Custom instructions, Saved memories and Chat history under Settings > Personalization are off and cannot be enabled by users.
claims.quote: End-users that have the Enhanced personalization control turned off see the user-level controls for Custom instructions, Saved memories, and Chat history in Settings > Personalization as turned off. They can't turn on these settings.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing: Meter; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The pages read publish no feature-specific price, credit rate or separate meter for communication memory.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Indirect cost
claims.claim: Microsoft Graph Explorer is the documented route to delete users' memory data across the briefing's listed clouds without a government-cloud qualification.
claims.quote: Because Microsoft Graph Explorer isn't available in the US Government cloud (GCC, GCC High, and DOD), you must use PowerShell to accomplish these tasks.
claims.fix: Add after the Graph Explorer sentence: 'For US Government clouds, the deletion guide says to use PowerShell because Microsoft Graph Explorer is unavailable.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/edisc-search-copilot-data.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Users can download their complete communication memory through profile card export.
claims.quote: Your complete Communication memory can be downloaded through the profile card export.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Turning off Enhanced personalization stops applying saved memories but does not remove them.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Saved memories control is turned off at the end-user level, Copilot is stopped from applying saved memories to the chat, but doesn't remove saved memories.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Turning off Enhanced personalization stops applying custom instructions but does not remove them.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Custom instruction control is turned off at the end-user level, Copilot is stopped from applying custom instructions, but doesn't remove those custom instructions.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: When Enhanced personalization is turned off, chat history details are deleted after 30 days.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Chat history control is turned off at the end-user level, then all details from chat history are deleted after 30 days.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: The setting's Graph API is beta, subject to change and unsupported for production applications.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.where: Open questions: communication memory retention
claims.claim: The cited retention section describes custom instructions, saved memories and chat history, not what happens specifically to communication memories when Enhanced personalization is disabled.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot memory retention policies labels communication memory admin retention'; read Learn /copilot/manage/copilot-personalization-memory retention section and /purview/edisc-search-copilot-data; neither states communication-memory retention after disabling Enhanced personalization.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, role assignment bullet
claims.claim: Assigning People Administrator or arranging PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All consent are alternative preparations for the person calling Graph.
claims.quote: Delegated (work or school account) | PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All ... For delegated access using work or school accounts, the admin must be assigned a supported Microsoft Entra role.
claims.fix: Replace the bullet with: 'For delegated access, assign the caller a supported Microsoft Entra role (People Administrator is the least privileged) and ensure the application has admin consent for PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All.' The update reference documents the role and permission; https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/permissions-reference#all-permissions marks this permission AdminConsentRequired: Yes.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The checklist asks administrators to test a Purview eDiscovery search, but the table contains only the Enhanced personalization setting.
claims.quote: Test a Purview eDiscovery search on item class IPM.Contact for one pilot user ... Whether Enhanced personalization (and so Copilot memory) is on for the organisation or off for one Entra group
claims.fix: Remove the 'Test a Purview eDiscovery search on item class IPM.Contact' checklist bullet: it instructs readers to check a control that has no row in the controls table. Keep the existing descriptive eDiscovery information.
